features.name: Copilot as everyday AI companion
features.description: Microsoft Copilot in Dynamics 365 Business Central serves as an everyday AI companion to help users save time by asking questions to find what they need and onboard quickly with guidance.

features.name: Marketing Tech suggestions for sales and creativity
features.description: Copilot accelerates sales and sparks creativity with marketing tech suggestions tailored to the user's unique brand using details already in Business Central like color, size, and material.

features.name: Copilot for creating sales documents
features.description: Copilot enables users to create sales quotes, orders, and invoices faster and easier than ever before, allowing investment of time in relationships instead of paperwork.

features.name: Business process automation with Power Automate
features.description: Simplify day-to-day work by automating business processes with Power Automate flows, allowing users to reclaim time for impactful work.

features.name: Finance organization with Copilot
features.description: Copilot helps keep finances organized from reconciling bank statements to matching purchase orders with e-invoices while using analysis views to make data-driven decisions.

features.name: Analysis views for data-driven decisions
features.description: Using analysis views to make data-driven decisions that propel business forward to new levels of success.
